messages.subject: PPAML summer school
parts:
In case anyone's interested in going. Note that they'd
like a proposal. This is hosted by Chad Scherer's company,

the parallel Gibbs sampler.

- Bob

> PPAML 2015 Summer School Announcement - July 20th to July 31st
>
> As part of the ?DARPA Probabilistic Programming for Advancing Machine Learning (PPAML) <http://www.darpa.mil/Our_Work/I2O/Programs/Probabilistic_Programming_for_Advanced_Machine_Learning_(PPAML).aspx> program, Galois is hosting the second of four annual summer schools on the topic this July in Portland, Oregon.
>
> The two week program is designed to teach participants the necessary background on probabilistic programming languages being developed as part of PPAML, and give them an opportunity to work directly with the creators of these languages to solve their own problems using these tools.
>
> During the summer school participants will provide feedback about the usability and performance of these probabilistic programming systems to help the PPAML program development teams improve their tools.
>
> Prerequisites
>
> Due to the mathematical nature of probabilistic programming systems, participants are expected to have existing knowledge in calculus and be comfortable with basic concepts related to working with probabilities and statistics. Experience with one or more numerical programming languages (such as R, Matlab, Python/Numpy, etc...) is desirable.
>
> Participants who include a brief proposal with their application of a problem that they would like to solve using a probabilistic programming system will be given preference in the participant selection process.
>
> Costs
>
> Housing for the two week period will be provided at the government per diem rate for Portland, Oregon. Participants are expected to cover their own travel and housing costs. A limited amount of financial assistance may be available for currently enrolled University students.
>
> Location: ?Embassy Suites Hotel, Portland Airport <http://embassysuites3.hilton.com/en/hotels/oregon/embassy-suites-portland-airport-PDXESES/index.html>
>
> Dates
>
> * March 28, 2015: Review of applications will begin on March 28th and will continue until the summer school is full.
> * April 30, 2015: Notification of acceptance for applications received by March 28th will be provided by April 30th.
> * June 01, 2015: All applicants will be notified by June 1st.
> * July 20, 2015: Summer school starts on July 20 and runs through July 31 in Portland, Oregon.
>
> Application
>
> To apply to the summer school click the following link and complete the ??application form <http://www.tfaforms.com/360103>.
>
> The application form will be closed when all slots at the summer school have been allocated.
>
> Please send your questions about the summer school and application process to ppaml-s...@community.galois.com <mailto:ppaml-s...@community.galois.com>
